candidates.label: A
candidates.notes: Multiple text errors: 「説明(えつめい)」furigana wrong, 「給与所得者」→「給与所得」, 「示している」→「示したものである」, 「上っている」furigana (あ) wrong (should be のぼ), 「違いなどが影響」→「など影響」(dropped が). Graph data incomplete/wrong: 女性 row has 23.8/16.9 instead of 23.5/15.9, missing small segments (2, 1, 0.6...), 男性 row 13.6→18.6, missing 18 and 4.4 values. Legend order scrambled and 900万円以下 misplaced.

candidates.label: B
candidates.notes: Body text nearly perfect with correct furigana (のぼ, しょとくしゃ etc.). Graph: 女性 row missing 15.9 duplicate/8.8-ish segment values partially but includes small segments; 男性 row has one '[illegible]' honestly marked (value 18), and 2.5/0.9/0.6 placed correctly. Legend rendered as table but order slightly reshuffled (400/500 moved to row 2). Furigana 「次の文(つぎ)」 attached oddly. Minor axis labels (0-100) omitted.

candidates.label: C
candidates.notes: Most complete: includes axis labels 0-100, all small segment values (0.6/0.3/0.1 etc.), full legend in correct order, paragraph break in body text preserved. Body text accurate with correct furigana. Minor issues: 女性 row includes 8.8 (segment value hard to verify, likely correct ~8.8), reads 18 for unclear segment (plausible inference), furigana 何(なん) vs image (likely なん, fine). Some invented readings for 参考 line furigana not shown in image (民間給与実態統計調査 reading not printed).

rationale: C is the most faithful and complete: correct body text and furigana, full graph values including tiny segments and axis, legend in correct order, and preserved paragraph structure; its only weakness is adding furigana readings not printed in the image (e.g., for the source line) and inferring one hard-to-read value. B is close behind with equally accurate body text and honest handling of an illegible value, but its legend order is slightly rearranged, axis labels are missing, and graph data is a bit less organized. A ranks last due to numerous character errors (wrong furigana えつめい/あ, dropped 者 and が, changed sentence ending), incorrect and incomplete graph values, and a scrambled legend.
